name: Neonatal Diabetes-Congenital Hypothyroidism-Congenital Glaucoma-Hepatic Fibrosis-Polycystic Kidneys Syndrome
aliases: Syndrome with Neonatal Diabetes, Congenital Hypothyroidism, and Multisystem Fibrocystic Disease

criteria.description: Onset of diabetes mellitus within the first 6 months of life
Biochemical evidence of hypothyroidism present at birth or early infancy
Clinical diagnosis of glaucoma with elevated intraocular pressure and optic nerve damage in infancy
Histological or imaging evidence of periportal fibrosis and liver dysfunction
Renal ultrasonography showing multiple bilateral renal cysts consistent with polycystic kidney disease

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of neonatal diabetes, congenital hypothyroidism, and congenital glaucoma; supportive evidence from hepatic fibrosis and polycystic kidneys findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by biochemical, imaging, and histopathological findings; genetic testing may assist if causative mutations are identified.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically presents within first 6 months of life

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital hypothyroidism with elevated TSH and low free T4
searchTerms: high TSH and low thyroid hormone in newborn

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital glaucoma with buphthalmos and corneal enlargement
searchTerms: congenital eye pressure causing big eye

common.symptomName: Polycystic kidneys causing enlarged renal size

rare.symptomName: Recurrent respiratory infections due to immunological compromise

laboratory: Elevated blood glucose with low or absent endogenous insulin
Elevated TSH with low free T4
Liver function abnormalities including elevated transaminases and bilirubin
imaging: Renal ultrasound showing bilateral multiple cysts
Liver ultrasound or MRI demonstrating periportal fibrosis
Ocular ultrasound or slit lamp confirming increased intraocular pressure and optic nerve cupping
other: Histopathology of liver biopsy showing periportal fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of congenital hypothyroidism and multisystem fibrocystic involvement
Primarily renal and hepatic involvement without endocrine abnormalities
Later onset of diabetes or hypothyroidism if present
Lack of neonatal diabetes and congenital glaucoma

redFlags: Onset of insulin-dependent diabetes within first 6 months of life
Congenital glaucoma presenting with buphthalmos and corneal clouding
Evidence of hepatic fibrosis with portal hypertension in infancy
